notes: Original conventional p value is not printed: the paper reports p_rep = .97, a different statistic, which has not been entered as p or converted. Original analytic total 43 is established by the printed condition counts 21 and 22 and explicit exclusion from 44 recruited; the total is not itself printed as a single N. PDF text extraction renders equals signs as 5 and partial eta squared as Zp 2; quotes retain these extraction artifacts. Replication values are reported verbatim from the authors’ primary post-completion OSF registration, verified by title. The printed replication p is retained without recalculation.
